clusters.headline: Indonesian Lawmakers Formalize Inquiry Into Vice President Gibran
aiSummaryBullets: A total of 120 members of the House of Representatives from eight political factions have submitted a proposal for the Right to Express Opinion.
The inquiry process concerns ongoing public and political discourse regarding the validity of Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka's educational credentials.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka Faces Exit Scenarios
aiSummaryBullets: Officials indicate that Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka has expressed an intention to resign from his position.
Parliamentary impeachment processes are proceeding despite the reported intent to resign, according to reports.

clusters.headline: Government Officials Deny Presidential Advice Regarding Legal Case
aiSummaryBullets: Head of Indonesian Government Communications Syahganda Nainggolan denied claims that President Prabowo advised Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka to contest diploma issues in court.
Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka previously stated an intention to pursue legal action at the Administrative Court (PTUN) to verify his high school diploma.

clusters.headline: President Prabowo Inaugurates Jade Mosque During Aceh Flag Event
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto officially inaugurated the Baitul A'la Jade Mosque in Nagan Raya, Aceh.
The mosque is reported to be the only house of worship in the world constructed primarily from jade stone.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Police Dismiss General Over Illegal Surveillance Claims
aiSummaryBullets: The Indonesian National Police has officially dismissed Irjen Ahrie Sonta after an ethics panel found him guilty of illegal wiretapping against President Prabowo Subianto.
Four active-duty generals, including a former National Police Chief, have been named suspects in the ongoing investigation into the surveillance incident.

clusters.headline: Officials Assess Yogyakarta Damage After Protests Lead To Arrests
aiSummaryBullets: Police have confirmed that 154 individuals were taken into custody following unrest at the DPRD DIY office and the Malioboro area.
The Yogyakarta Governor, Sultan Hamengku Buwono X, engaged directly with demonstrators by sitting on the ground to hear their concerns.

clusters.headline: President Prabowo Subianto Confers National Hero Titles To Nineteen
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto officially designated nineteen individuals as National Heroes.
The list of recipients includes historical figures such as Marhum Pekan, RM Margono, and Kiai Abbas.

clusters.headline: Heavy Rains Trigger Multiple Landslides Across South Jakarta Areas
aiSummaryBullets: Severe rainfall triggered multiple landslides across Mampang Prapatan, Pasar Minggu, and Kemang districts in South Jakarta.
Five homes in the Kemang area sustained damage after a local parking facility collapsed, affecting eight families.

clusters.headline: Indonesian House Sets Plenary Meeting On Impeachment Proposal
aiSummaryBullets: A total of 120 members of the House of Representatives from eight political factions have formally submitted an opinion expression rights proposal.
House leadership confirmed the proposal regarding the eligibility of Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka has met all formal requirements.

clusters.headline: President Prabowo Subianto Inaugurates Facilities In Nagan Raya
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto arrived in Nagan Raya, Aceh, to officially inaugurate the Baitul A'la Jade Mosque and a local public school.
Minister of Home Affairs Tito Karnavian visited the region to distribute disaster recovery equipment, including water pumps and community aid.
